prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective single “best” dentist for every implant case. A strong Atlanta option to consider is **Dr. Brock Pumphrey at Atlanta Center for Advanced Periodontics**: the practice says he is board-certified in periodontology and dental implant surgery, and has offices in Midtown and Sandy Springs. [Practice details](https://advancedperioatl.com/implants/)

Other credentialed options include **Dr. Andreina Izarra** at Periodontal Associates of Georgia, who the practice lists as board-certified in periodontology and a Diplomate of the International Congress of Oral Implantologists, and **Dr. Evan Grodin**, described by his practice as dual board-certified in prosthodontics and periodontics. [Izarra’s practice](https://www.periogeorgia.com/) · [Grodin’s implant practice](https://www.drevangrodin.com/dental-implants/)

Before choosing, get at least two consultations and ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what imaging and bone-grafting may be needed, the full written cost, and what follow-up or warranty is included. Check that the dentist’s credentials and Georgia license are current, and choose based on your specific case, comfort, and insurance—not reviews alone.
